description:
We have identified a problem where many individuals possess talents and skills in various fields, but they lack opportunities to showcase their abilities due to a lack of startup capital. On the other hand, there are capitalists who have ample wealth but are seeking individuals with sufficient talent.

To address this issue, we have conceived the idea of developing a website based on the Blockchain system, offering the advantage of variability. It functions as a platform for individuals to showcase their work, enabling others to view their talents. Users can register their work and allow others to vote on it, based on the principles of the DAO Projects. This approach creates incentives for voters, and the prize money will be transferred to APE COIN based on the proportions defined in the Smart Contract, ensuring fairness for all parties involved.
how_its_made:
Our project utilizes DAO technology for voting, with @ApeCoin DAO serving as the main coin for transferring rewards to our winners and campaign participants. We opted for ApeCoin DAO due to its popularity and widespread interest. For testing and development purposes, we selected Chain @Filecoin, which offers advantages such as speed and the ability to obtain free coins for system testing. Additionally, we use @Polybase, a blockchain-based database, to ensure transparency and verification of our main data, including drawings, videos, and all published works. We store this data on @IPFS because of its user-friendly interface and efficient file storage capabilities. To facilitate the storage of data to IPFS, we partnered with @NFT.storage as an intermediary.  Currently, we allowing users who apply through our system and own confirmed works to upload their files using @Lighthouse as an intermediary. These files are then stored in the Filecoin virtual machine deal to enhance their value and provide opportunities for external involvement with the works.
Finally, for system deployment, we have chosen @spheron, which offers fast and free usage, enabling users to create campaigns and showcase their favorite works. Throughout our project, we meticulously selected partners that align with our job requirements and development timeline. We sincerely appreciate the availability of these exceptional tools.
